exposure: Implementation of WHO's Essential Newborn Care package
outcome: Intent to breastfeed exclusively for 6 months or more
cohort: 286 mothers in the postnatal wards of Da Nang Hospital for Women and Children in central Viet Nam
finding: High rates of early breastfeeding establishment and intent to breastfeed exclusively for 6 months or more were likely due to high levels of maternal education and successful implementation of the WHO Essential Newborn Care package.
mod_finding: Amongst mothers struggling to establish breastfeeding, 18/27 (66.7%) had a Cesarean section.
